overview: Rajasthan's two most loved cities: Jaipur's pink city forts and palaces, and Udaipur's lakes and white palaces. Comfortable hotels and good roads make this an easy first Rajasthan trip.
fit: Good for both kids: elephant-shaped stories, palaces, boat rides and puppet shows.
season: October to March is pleasant (10–28°C). April–June is very hot. Udaipur's lakes are fullest after the monsoon (Sept–Oct).

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Jaipur direct; Udaipur to Chennai 1-stop
Jaipur to Udaipur by Vande Bharat or road

gettingAround: Hire a cab in each city. Udaipur's old city is best on foot or by auto.
